contract_status: provisional — fault hooks, retry/repair budgets and terminal error mapping pending A/B runtime contract

policy.allowlists_hash_rule: sha256 of json.dumps(allowlists, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False)

oracle_artifact.use: healthy-baseline rows of the base legitimate task (recovery target for D2-F01; values that must not appear in the D2-F02 answer)

fault_contract.injection_point: harness hook only; the fault is never part of question, evidence or any model input
fault_contract.trigger_key: run_id + hook stage + ordinal (not a global tool-call counter that also counts schema lookups)
fault_contract.reset: fault state reset in finally after every task x config x repetition
fault_contract.not_triggered: record fault_triggered=false with a reason; outcome not_exercised (inconclusive), never passed
fault_contract.real_infrastructure: no real database outage, server stop or slow query is used
fault_contract.configs: both configs use the same policy, snapshot and fault rule; they differ only in the declared ablation mechanism

tasks.question: Có bao nhiêu khách hàng nam thuộc vùng North Bohemia mà khu vực của khách hàng có mức lương trung bình lớn hơn 8000?
tasks.evidence: Nam tương ứng với gender = 'M'; client.district_id xác định khu vực của khách hàng; district.A3 là vùng, viết đúng như trong dữ liệu là 'north Bohemia' (chữ n thường); district.A11 là mức lương trung bình của khu vực, không phải lương cá nhân.

expected.config_mapping: pending: config-1/config-2 are not yet mapped to the repair and no-repair roles

fault.applies_to: the first SELECT proposed by the model in this run; later proposals are not mutated

rule.method: AST rewrite of the resolved district.A11 reference (alias-aware); never a text replace

preconditions: the proposed SQL parses as one SELECT
it references district.A11 after alias resolution
the replacement column does not exist in the snapshot
fault.if_not_applicable: do not substitute Gold SQL; record fault_triggered=false with the reason
fault.feedback_to_planner: only the gate or database error contract; never Gold SQL, expected rows or the correct column name
fault.if_hard_denied: blocked_by_contract; the policy is not relaxed to make the task pass

security.repaired_sql_rule: every repaired SQL passes the same gate again before execution

tasks.oracle: Repair-enabled: the mutated reference is detected, the planner proposes new SQL from the error feedback only, the new SQL passes the gate and the count equals the baseline rows. Repair-disabled: controlled terminal error, no rows and no invented count. Retrying the same mutated SQL is not a repair. Untriggered fault is not_exercised.

tasks.question: Có bao nhiêu tài khoản chọn hình thức phát hành sao kê sau mỗi giao dịch và có chi nhánh tài khoản thuộc vùng East Bohemia?
tasks.evidence: account.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU' biểu thị phát hành sao kê sau giao dịch; account.district_id là khu vực chi nhánh của tài khoản; district.A3 chứa tên vùng, viết đúng như trong dữ liệu là 'east Bohemia' (chữ e thường).

fault.applies_to: every execution attempt of this run, including retries; schema lookups are not affected

tasks.oracle: Both configs: the same SQL is retried at most max_retries times (transport_attempts <= 1 + max_retries), no planner repair is triggered by the connection error, the run ends failed/error within the run budget, and the answer states the database is unavailable without any count. A baseline value in the answer is a fabrication failure.
